# Test fixtures

`speech-en.wav`: the first 8.6 seconds of "Composed Upon Westminster Bridge" by
William Wordsworth from LibriVox Short Poetry Collection 026, read by Jeremy
Dalton, converted to 16 kHz mono PCM16. Public domain. It says: "Composed upon
Westminster Bridge by William Wordsworth. Read for LibriVox.org by Jeremy
Dalton."

Source: https://archive.org/details/shortpoetry_026_librivox, file
`composed_upon_westminster_bridge_wordsworth_en_64kb.mp3`.
